user.title: Connect a FRIDAY voice satellite
user.description: Use the dedicated credential issued for this device in FRIDAY satellite administration. Home controls require an explicitly selected HA connection and device permissions in FRIDAY. Personal data and administrator access are unavailable. HA uses native random bearer URLs for audio.
